metadata.source: ECMWF IFS 0.25 deg (open data) via Open-Meteo
metadata.rule: MODERATE: 3-day snowfall >= tile P95 (and >= 10 mm) with 3-day max gust >= tile P95, or 3-day Tmax rise >= tile P95 after 7-day snowfall >= tile P90 (and >= 20 mm) on a snowpack. HIGH: 3-day snowfall >= tile P99 (and >= 25 mm) with gust >= tile P90, or the warm-snow part at HIGH thresholds. Tiles below 1200 m mean elevation are not rated.
